response.sql:
WITH matched_snapshots AS (
  SELECT
    tr.transreg AS transaction_reference,
    tr.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
    sf.shortintrt,
    sf.optvolrt
  FROM transactionrecord AS tr
  JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
    ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
), transaction_averages AS (
  SELECT
    transaction_reference,
    order_type_mix,
    AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest,
    AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio
  FROM matched_snapshots
  GROUP BY transaction_reference, order_type_mix
), mix_baselines AS (
  SELECT
    order_type_mix,
    AVG(shortintrt) AS baseline_short_interest
  FROM matched_snapshots
  GROUP BY order_type_mix
)
SELECT
  ta.transaction_reference,
  ta.order_type_mix,
  ta.avg_short_interest,
  ta.avg_option_volume_ratio,
  ta.avg_short_interest / NULLIF(mb.baseline_short_interest, 0) AS short_interest_ratio_to_baseline
FROM transaction_averages AS ta
JOIN mix_baselines AS mb
  ON mb.order_type_mix IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ta.order_type_mix
ORDER BY short_interest_ratio_to_baseline DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The order-type baseline uses all matched sentiment snapshots in that mix, with each snapshot counted once; SQL AVG ignores null short-interest values, and a zero or missing baseline yields a missing ratio.
